sufficiency_assessment.bottleneck_diagnosis: The training corpus comprises only 149 instruction-response pairs and ~12,400 words of background prose (~23,300 tokens total). In modern language modeling, learning English morphology, syntax, long-range dependencies, and robust instruction-following from scratch requires orders of magnitude more tokens (typically 100M+ tokens for a 5M parameter model). With only ~23k tokens, a 5.3M model has over 200 parameters per training token, resulting in severe data starvation and inability to generalize syntax. Furthermore, causal language modeling optimizes next-token loss on the prompt text as well as the response, wasting capacity on learning to predict user queries rather than focusing strictly on generating well-formed answers.
expansion_strategy: Source 1: Official Karnataka State Disaster Management Authority (KSDMA) coastal SOPs and taluk disaster management plans.
Source 2: IMD Cyclone Warning Manual, cyclone tracking protocols, and classification scales (NDSAP Open Data).
Source 3: Saaty (1980) AHP mathematical proofs and pairwise matrix calculations (public academic fair use).
Source 4: Census 2011 Village and Town Directory metadata for Dakshina Kannada, Udupi, and Uttara Kannada (OGD Platform India).
Source 5: Loss-masking optimization: Compute cross-entropy loss exclusively on the <assistant> response tokens, zeroing loss on <user> tokens.
